  • ◆Mandate · Provide the Council speaker and publish on the commission website a written report detailing qualifying crash reviews in the prior quarter, summary suspensions, and enforcement actions following those reviews.
    report · deadline 2015-02-01 · quarterly · Administrative Code §19-540(b) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Post on the city’s website and submit to the mayor and council speaker an annual report containing specified findings and program and resource information.
    report · deadline 2019-12-15 · annual · § 2305(d) · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit a report on the study’s findings to the mayor and the speaker of the council.
    report · deadline 2026-06-27 · one-time · Section 1 · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Provide a report to the council for the prior quarter reporting the number of crashes involving a vehicle licensed by the commission, disaggregated by vehicle type and whether critical injury or death resulted.
    report · deadline: On or before February 1, 2015 · quarterly · Administrative Code §19-540 · Source law↗
  • ◆Mandate · Submit recommendations to the Council Speaker and Mayor for mitigating impacts identified by the study, including proposals concerning issuance of for-hire vehicle and specified base-station licenses.
    report · deadline: Following the completion of study on the impact of growth in the taxicab and for-hire vehicle industries · one-time · Section 8 · Source law↗
